output.body:
Dear {vendor} team,

We are writing to dispute charges under {agreement} for our hosting services.

The agreement states: "{cap_clause}" Our monthly fee for the prior term was {prior_monthly}, so the most that could be billed for the renewal term is {max_allowed_monthly}.

The renewal raised our monthly fee to {charged_monthly}, an increase of {actual_increase_pct} that exceeds the {cap_pct} cap. The overcharge is {overcharge_monthly} per month, which totals {overcharged_to_date} on {invoices}.

Please take the following actions:

1. Issue a credit for the full overcharged amount of {overcharged_to_date}.
2. Reissue {invoices} at no more than {max_allowed_monthly} per month.
3. Bill all future renewal-term invoices in line with the cap in the agreement.

Please confirm receipt of this dispute and let us know when the credit and corrected invoices will be issued.

Kind regards,
{sender}
